name: University of Kent
description:
The University of Kent is a internationally-leading academic institution with over 97% of their research judged as of international quality in the Research Excellence Framework. They have been awarded TEF Gold and are also ranked in the Top 10% of World Universities for International Outlook in the Times Higher Education Guide 2020.

With their main campus situated in the charming and friendly city of Canterbury, in the heart of rural England, students are surrounded by beautiful woodlands and can explore all the county has to offer. The Medway Campus is a bustling community where different disciplines form a central hub. It is home to student accommodation, a wealth of shops, bars, cafes and restaurants as well as specialist learning facilities.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of Kent is a great choice if you're looking for a well-rounded university experience in the UK. You’ll be studying on beautiful campuses in Canterbury or Medway, surrounded by modern facilities. Kent provides you with over 300 undergraduate and postgraduate programs to choose from.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll have a vibrant and inclusive student life at the University of Kent. With over 250 clubs and societies facilitated by Kent Students' Union, there's something for everyone. Events like the Welcome Fair and The Big Fair are perfect for you to discover new communities and make new friends. Plus, the Student Support and Wellbeing team provides you with a variety of services, including one-on-one and peer support groups, regular mindfulness sessions, and both in-person and online mental health support.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Kent provides diverse accommodation options to suit your lifestyle and preferences. You get student accommodation in either en-suite or shared rooms. Some accommodations come with a Flex Meal Plan, providing you with prepaid credit to use at various campus food outlets.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Templeman Library is the main library at the University of Kent's Canterbury campus. You have a modern, four-story building with a 250-seat lecture theatre and 8 seminar rooms.

Sports
Kent Sport offers you extensive sports facilities, including a large fitness suite, multi-use sports halls, floodlit artificial pitches, and indoor tennis courts. You can also get physiotherapy and rehabilitation services at the Kent Sports Clinic.

Laboratory
You'll find modern labs across various disciplines at the university, with state-of-the-art equipment. For example, the Sport and Exercise Sciences department features labs for physiology, biomechanics, and psychobiology, along with specialised equipment.

Cafeteria
The Library Cafe offers you a selection of drinks and snacks. Plus, you can also get breakfast and lunch at the Gulbenkian Arts Centre Cafe.
